docker.name: github-release-monitor
docker.description: Self-hosted dashboard that watches GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, and self-hosted Forgejo repositories for new releases and notifies you by email or Apprise.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Stores the Better Auth SQLite database. Must be writable by UID/GID 1001 (the container's non-root user) — e.g. run `chown -R 1001:1001 ./data` on the host directory before first start.

variables.description: Auth mode: Basic (internal login required), AllowUnauthenticated (public read-only home; login required for changes/settings), or External (behind Authelia, Authentik, TinyAuth, NGINX Basic auth, etc.).
Set to false for a direct HTTP setup with no reverse proxy in front (this template's default). Affects session cookies and security headers.
Required. At least 32 characters. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32
Required. Public base URL of the app — must match the URL you'll open in your browser, e.g. http://<your-ip>:8080
Required. One-time token for creating the first admin account. At least 32 characters. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32
Keep self-service signup disabled by default; the first admin account is created via the AUTH_SETUP_TOKEN flow.
Enable WebAuthn passkeys for passwordless login.
Lockout duration (seconds) once the failed-login threshold is reached.
Time window (seconds) used to count failed login attempts.
Maximum failed login attempts before lockout starts.
Enable only when a trusted reverse proxy overwrites client IP headers. Leave false for this direct/no-proxy setup.
Number of trusted proxy entries at the right side of X-Forwarded-For (only relevant if AUTH_TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS=true).
Lifetime of password-reset links in seconds (60-86400).
Trust configured social login providers for automatic account linking by email.
Optional GitHub OAuth client ID, for social login.
Optional GitHub OAuth client secret.
Optional Google OAuth client ID, for social login.
Optional Google OAuth client secret.
Recommended. A scopeless GitHub Personal Access Token raises the GitHub API rate limit from 60 to 5000 requests/hour.
Optional. Comma-separated additional GitLab instance hostnames besides gitlab.com.
Optional. Comma-separated host=token pairs for private GitLab repos (scopes: read_api, read_repository).
Optional. Comma-separated host=username:token pairs (deploy token scope: read_repository).
Optional. Token for monitoring private Codeberg repos (needs read:repository).
Optional. Comma-separated allowed self-hosted Forgejo base URLs.
Optional. Comma-separated base-url=token pairs for private Forgejo repos (needs read:repository).
Optional — required only for email notifications. Your SMTP server host.
SMTP server port.
SMTP username.
SMTP password or app token.
Verify the SMTP server's TLS certificate. Only disable for a controlled internal relay.
The "from" address for notification emails.
The "from" display name for notification emails.
The address notification emails are sent to.

Optional. URL of a separate Apprise API service (e.g. http://apprise:8000/notify) for push/chat notifications. Requires running a companion Apprise container — not included in this single-container template.
Container timezone, e.g. Etc/UTC.
Locale. C.UTF-8 is a minimal POSIX locale with UTF-8 support.
